---
applyTo: "src/components/**/*.tsx"
description: "Use when: creating or updating reusable React UI components"
---

# Front Components Rules

- Use functional components with typed props.
- Keep components small and reusable; extract complex logic to hooks when needed.
- Reuse CoreUI patterns already used in the project.
- Keep loading, empty, and error states explicit when data is involved.
- Avoid introducing a new design language if equivalent CoreUI patterns exist.
- Preserve mobile and desktop responsiveness.
